question.question: Can Vagabond craft a card requiring fox and rabbit icons from one clearing, reuse the pawn for multiple craftings, and immediately use a crafted item?

expected.expected_answer: Cannot satisfy mixed suits because clearing must match every icon. Each icon exhausts hammer, pawn may activate repeatedly ignoring once/turn cap. Crafted item can immediately be taken face up, usable if otherwise eligible.

source_passages.quotation: - **Craft:** Exhaust one hammer per crafting icon; pawn acts as crafting piece matching current clearing, and may activate repeatedly despite normal once-per-turn crafting limit. Clearing must match **all icons**; cannot craft mixed fox/rabbit/mouse requirements from one clearing. When you craft an item, you may immediately take that item face up into Satchel/track and **use it for another Daylight action immediately**, if its cost and other requirements are met. Need supply item as usual.

answer.ruling: No. Vagabond's current clearing must match all crafting icons; a single clearing cannot pay mixed fox and rabbit requirements.
The pawn may activate repeatedly in a turn, despite the normal once-per-turn crafting limit, but Vagabond still exhausts one hammer per crafting icon.

When crafting an item, Vagabond may immediately take it face up into Satchel or a track and use it for another Daylight action immediately, if its cost and other requirements are met. The item must be available in the map supply as usual.
